analogy.rationale: Norepinephrine reuptake inhibitors block NET, but these cell lines express little NET and the annotated off-targets (adrenergic, muscarinic, dopamine receptors) are only weakly engaged at 10 uM, so transcriptional response should be weak; other monoamine reuptake inhibitors and tricyclics share the same limited pharmacology, while adrenergic antagonists overlap only the receptor off-targets.
